name: Gun Mayhem 2: More Mayhem

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host sets up Custom Game with the friends as HUMAN players, then starts the match.

keys.key: Arrows or W A S D

tips: The host is Player 1 and only the host's mouse works in the menus.
Esc and Space (pause) are turned off in online play.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.
Play on one keyboard (up to four players) is under Other ways to connect, once Settings shows offline play.

description: Knock each other off floating platforms with guns, in free-for-all or team matches against friends and bots. Online play runs in Ruffle Together: the host is Player 1 and friends join as Players 2, 3 and 4.

original.description: The Armor Games release, without the online mod
